description: This source file implements the TTSDownloader class responsible for downloading Text-To-Speech files via HTTP using libcurl, managing download threads, and handling download retries and configuration updates.

classes.name: TTSDownloader
classes.description: Class responsible for managing TTS audio download threads, executing download requests, and handling file transfer and configuration updates.

methods.name: TTSDownloader::download
methods.description: Initiates a download process based on provided configuration, launching a new thread if necessary.

methods.name: TTSDownloader::downloadThread
methods.description: Thread entry point that waits for download trigger, constructs the URL, performs the download via libcurl, and handles retries.

methods.name: TTSDownloader::downloadFile
methods.description: Performs file download from the specified URL with libcurl and saves it to a local path.

methods.name: TTSDownloader::saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the fallback path configuration after a successful download.
